_comment: How each people builds its first village (keyed by race, lower case). first: works that come sooner (x1.6 urgency); late: works that come later (x0.5); stone_first: the hut and works in stone even where timber grows; keep_trees: no tree inside the wall is felled; say: the line the log gives at founding.

dwarf.say: They are dwarves: they build in stone before timber, and the store and the workshop come before the field.

elf.say: They are elves: no tree inside the wall will be felled, and the timber comes from further off.

orc.say: They are orcs: the wall goes up before the second roof, and a lookout before a store.

goblin.say: They are goblins: walls and a lookout first, fields when they must.

halfling.say: They are halflings: they farm early and store well, and wall themselves in last.

human.say: They are humans: fields and roofs spread outward, and the wall comes last.
